tools.name: find_rooms
tools.description: Which of the twelve New Leaf properties in Twin Falls has a room free tonight or on particular nights. Checks all twelve live for the requested dates. The published availability feeds carry CAPACITY, not vacancy, and say nothing about which nights are taken. With no dates it answers for tonight and

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: All twelve New Leaf properties: name, address, phone, which room types each sells online, its rates and its booking URL. Static facts only; it says nothing about whether a room is free tonight.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: What a room costs across the portfolio, by the night and by the week, and the rules that govern a stay: the minimum stay, how a stay under a week is priced, the 30-day cap, the weekly-only studio rule, the 8% Idaho lodging tax, and why $1,000 is never a monthly rate.

tools.name: quote_stay
tools.description: The total for one stay at one New Leaf property: the nights, the tax and what is paid at the property. Asks that property live and returns its quote, with source attribution on booking links, so the figure is the one its booking form uses, and passes on its refusal when a stay cannot be sold. Requir

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Validates and prices a stay, checks current availability without holding a room, and emails a six-digit code. Requires the property, room type, dates, guest name, email and contact phone. The intent and code last 15 minutes. An identical start while its intent remains open returns the same booking_i

tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Verifies the code the guest received by email for a booking_id, then holds an available room and submits the reservation for staff confirmation within 24 hours. Requires that booking_id and six-digit code. Repeating the same valid pair returns the same reservation. After email proof, checks stays ma

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Reads a reservation status, property, room type, dates and total using its reservation number and the last four digits of its contact phone. Does not return the guest name, email or full phone. Well-formed references with incorrect details return no reservation found; only failed lookups count towar

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels in two steps. The first mode takes reservation_number and phone_last4, emails a code and returns cancel_id. The second mode takes cancel_id and code, cancels the reservation, releases the room and notifies staff and guest. Automated cancellation is available more than 48 hours before check-i

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_properties, start_booking, confirm_booking, get_booking, cancel_booking · Private data: start_booking, confirm_booking, get_booking · Public sink: start_booking, confirm_booking, get_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_properties, start_booking, confirm_booking, get_booking, cancel_booking · Private data: start_booking, confirm_booking, get_booking · Public sink: start_booking, confirm_booking, get_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
